verdict.rationale: First-party docs show SmartScan reading merchant, date, total and currency from a phone photo of a receipt, and community users confirm that receipt data gets extracted and entered for them. Hands-on reports note that processing can be slow (around 20 minutes) and that it may involve human transcription, which tempers the realtime claim but does not negate the capability. Missing for 10: email-forwarding receipt capture, automatic matching of the receipt to the correct card transaction, and independent corroboration of OCR accuracy and speed.
